QUINTORA

The Magical Game of Five in a Row ✦

The Houses

✦ Align five active tiles of your house to earn 10 house points.

Game Information

Game Rules

View the Rules

Basics: Place one tile per turn. Every tile after the first must touch an existing tile along a full side. The playing field must always remain connected.

Muggle Rules: Once all your tiles are placed, move one of your own tiles on each turn.

Wizarding Rules: Once all your tiles are placed, cast one spell per turn. If Expelliarmus returns a tile to your hand, you must place it on your next turn.

Face-down tiles do not count toward a winning line but still connect the playing field. Five in a row wins.

🌐 Online
Choose players and a game mode to begin.

Your Spells

In Wizarding Rules, spells unlock once you have placed all your tiles.

Magical Notes

Drag to pan the board and use the + / − buttons to zoom. Select a tile before moving or removing it.

✦ A face-down tile hides its house. Remember who it belongs to!
